texts.orig: CIM is quantum-inspired   optimization   technique that leverages  principles  from the model. The Ising model represents optimization   problems as energy minimization tasks, where the is to find the ground state of a system by  minimizing its energy. In the context of combinatorial optimization; this  ground state corresponds to an optimal  or near-optimal   solution. CIM   utilizes an optical   network of degenerate optical parametric oscillators (DOPOs) to represent spins in the phase-coherent laser pulses; with the two possible phases corresponding to spin values of +1 or _1. The energy is minimized by   continuously   adjusting the pump   power allowing CIM to evolve the spin states toward lower energy configurations and find solutions to the optimization problem.
